name: hep solar
note: German solar company (hep global GmbH, Güglingen); VfB Stuttgart's sleeve sponsor before GREENOX, which took over the sleeve for 2026/27 (Footy Headlines), so no longer on the current home kit. Rating note: the register names hep global holding GmbH as shareholder; the founders and 'other shareholders' are thanked in the company's announcement, but the holding's shareholders are not public (North Data counts five, names paywalled). FH Capital, a Hong Kong-based financial investor, provides mezzanine capital to the US subsidiary HEP Solar Holdings USA (BondGuide, 21 May 2026): financing for a subsidiary, not a stake in hep global GmbH. No state or state-fund owner found.
verdict: German solar company (hep global GmbH, Güglingen) founded by Christian Hamann and Thorsten Eitle, held through hep global holding GmbH. Nothing found.
